rationale: M60/#924, the cpp row's SECOND name-surface class, landed from the census's own files and measured over the two pinned cpp corpora (script/m14/tmp/c924-adjudicate.ts: 570 files, 17,426 symbols). 825 of the 848 whitespace-bearing symbol names are the DELIBERATE #919 macro-heading contract (metadata.expandedFrom === 'macro-heading'); 52 were neither, and 33 of those are ONE grammar mechanism reproduced here: when a macro stands where the return type begins, the cpp grammar cannot place the type and rejoins it to the declarator as extra qualifier segments separated by WHITESPACE ONLY — the qid's `::` separator slot carries a `::` token with EMPTY text (emitted evidence: script/m14/tmp/c924-qid-shape.ts). The old rule read the OUTER qid's last segment as the name and the segment above it as the owner, so fmt/os.h:122 published `system_error vwindows_error` owned by a class `system_error` and json.hpp:5263 published `string to_string` owned by `string`. MEASURED A/B against HEAD over both corpora (script/m14/tmp/c924qid-ab.ts, same tree, both implementations): non-macro whitespace names 52 -> 19 (the 19 remaining are `operator` spellings, intrinsic to the language), 152 symbols moved from `method` to `function` — they were members of a phantom class that does not exist — 2 constructors became correctly detectable, 5 genuine qualified declarators dropped their inlined owner from the NAME while keeping the owner (SocketWriter::MakeConnection -> MakeConnection in SocketWriter), symbol count identical (17,391 -> 17,391), nameLine identical (0 changed: the #921 contract is untouched), and the whole edge delta is the rename itself propagating to the edges' endpoints (106 contains + 1 uses lost, 33 contains + 1 uses added, every pair matching by target and line). The rule is exported (`qualifiedDeclaratorLeaf`) and the F5 oracle imports it rather than copying it (#916), so this fixture — not the differential — is the independent gate for the class. **Reverting mutant: `cpp/qualified-declarator-name-glue`** (mutate-analyzer.ts) restores the outer-segment read; this fixture is the only one that catches it.
